    • The rider's prima facie case shifts the burden to the driver under POL-RD-08, and the driver discharges it by naming a specific artifact and a specific clause from the list POL-RD-08 gives: EV-TRIP-02838, whose amendment timestamps are the artifact, and POL-RD-05, the exculpatory clause. The driver asserts no uncited traffic excuse, so nothing turns on POL-RD-08's bar against bare assertion. kept
    • Even taking the rider's own trace figure at face value, the excess is 3.2 km over a 10.0 km booked optimal, 32%, which clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but is not MATERIAL: POL-RD-01 sets materiality at more than 50% or more than 8.0 km absolute, and neither is met. The rider therefore cannot reach the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) on this trip's evidence, whatever else is decided. kept
    • Nor is any repeat-deviation pattern established under POL-RD-06: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the three-flag threshold, and 1 divided by 207 completed_trips_90d is about 0.005, far below the 0.05 ratio threshold. Those two fields are the only profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for this test, so the rider's remedy cannot be uplifted to FULL_REFUND and no driver-conduct referral follows from the profile. kept
    • The escalation does not rest on trace impairment, and the tribunal should name the right trigger. The gps_trace is clean for policy purposes: 104 fixes at a 10 second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) never fires and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The trigger that fires is POL-RD-10(5), the missing amended re-quote. kept
    • No traffic advisory covers this corridor: EV-ADVIS-02838-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT, and the driver asserts no external traffic cause. Under POL-RD-13 an absent advisory that no party cites is a gap in the bundle, not the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction of 'a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory', so it neither exonerates nor incriminates the driver and supplies no second escalation trigger. kept

The decision

POL-GEN-06(4) names exactly four decisions:

nothing to adopt: the panel's best-supported proposal is ESCALATE.

Adopt the panel's proposal. The command carries the proposal's own ruling and amount, and the clauses the packet relied on.




Name the record-type items required, and when the window opens. The reviewer opens one window for both parties at once.

part 26: the evidence window is ops/evidence_window.py, which opens one window to both parties at once; the command below names the store it writes to, and that store is not tracked.

(at least 20 characters, citing one evidence id of this case and one clause id of the policy)

This form closes nothing by itself: there is no server. It checks the reason and builds the command; recording the decision is a command a person runs.
